summary: Publish route has no state guard: force-publishing a non-draft (null content) 500s the public /blog index and homepage via dekFromContent(null)
description: src/app/api/admin/blog/[id]/publish/route.ts calls setStatus(id,'published') with no check on current status. migration 013 leaves title/slug/content nullable with no CHECK constraints. dekFromContent (blog-public.ts:50) does content.split() which throws on null. So force-publishing a queued/needs_attention row (content NULL) makes listPublished throw -> 500s BOTH the public /blog index and the homepage feed (both call listPublished). Not reachable via UI (Publish only on drafts) but unguarded API with large blast radius. Fix: (a) guard setStatus publish transition to require status='draft' AND content NOT NULL; (b) defensively make dekFromContent null-safe and have listPublished skip null-content/null-slug rows. Add tests.
